How Germany national team connects

  • Event: 2014 FIFA World Cup — Germany won the 2014 World Cup in Brazil.
  • Item: FIFA World Cup Trophy — Germany lifted the current trophy in 2014.

What is Germany national team?

Germany — as West Germany and then a unified side — has four World Cup titles, the last in 2014 when they beat Argentina in Rio.
